observations.source_data_note: ICASA's March 2026 report describes a standardized 2 GB mobile-broadband basket costing R152 per month for the 2024 reference period.
terms: National standardized basket, not a named retail offer
Not equivalent to a 10 GB bundle with time-of-day restrictions
Does not establish affordability for every household
comparison_exclusions: Different product definition from retail prepaid bundles
No named site coverage or device assumptions
Does not include the proposed community network's full operating costs

observations.source_data_note: The indexed official page lists 5 GB Anytime plus 5 GB Night Owl for R99 over 30 days, including VAT.
terms: 5 GB Night Owl allocation with time restrictions
Availability, eligibility, signal quality and actual throughput were not independently tested
Page price can change; revalidate before procurement
comparison_exclusions: Time-of-day allocation differs from a single unrestricted 10 GB allowance
No device or site-level coverage test
Not directly equivalent to ICASA's standardized 2 GB basket

explicit_non_claims: No claim these observations are equivalent products
No claim any community network is cheaper than either observed offer
No claim of measured coverage, throughput, reliability or task quality
No claim a price observation is guaranteed to remain available
No claim that ICASA's standardized national basket is a named retail tariff
